scoring_justification: Recompute maxima from the raw CSV artifacts and compare to paper-reported gold values with tolerances; a structural trend check confirms the non-monotonic diameter dependence.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported maximum ZT and corresponding Fermi-level values for bulk, surface (gapless and d=10 nm), and total nanowire at d=10 nm, plus bulk ZT for structural trend.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and abstract: bulk ZT_b maxima (0.84, 0.17, 0.06) with Ef from fig.1; surface ZT_s maxima for gapless (0.49,0.25,0.47) and d=10nm (0.91,0.58,0.87) with Ef; total nanowire ZT at d=10nm (0.28,0.55,0.18) from description.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hardcoded values transcribed from the paper's reported numbers (e.g., Fig.1, Fig.3 description).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly quoted or derived from unambiguous statements in the paper; they are the targets the paper itself reports.

outputs.description: Bulk ZT vs Fermi level for each material.
Surface ZT vs Fermi level for each material and diameter case.
Optimal total nanowire ZT and corresponding Fermi level for each diameter and material.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker will extract the maximum ZT and corresponding Fermi levels from each CSV, compare against hidden paper-reported values with tolerances, and verify that ZT_opt at d=10 nm is less than ZT_opt at d=10 μm for each material (structural trend check).
